author: SpicyTunaRoll9
body:
By infusing the DNA of a ghast into a minecraft player, you have been granted the special power of a Ghast.
Level 42.
Ghast Rod (Cooldown time 4 seconds)
Stone Sword 
Full Leather Armor

Ghast Rod- Launch the explosive projectiles that the ghasts do by right clicking with your blaze rod!
*Note: Just as how with kit engineer you can damage yourself with your own tnt, the same applies for the explosive projectiles.
*Edit: Buffed.
